test_name: Verify User Role Management in Admin Panel
description: This test ensures that an admin can manage user roles by making a user an admin, revoking admin rights, and deleting a user.
steps: Log in as an admin user.
Navigate to the Admin tab using the 'Admin' link.
Locate the user 'bhhavya.sureka' in the user list.
Click the 'Make Admin' button beside the user 'bhhavya.sureka'.
Verify that the user role changes to 'Admin'.
Click the 'Remove Admin' button beside the user 'bhhavya.sureka'.
Verify that the user role changes back to 'User'.
Click the 'Delete User' button beside the user 'bhhavya.sureka'.
Confirm deletion in the confirmation dialog.
Verify that the user 'bhhavya.sureka' is removed from the user list.
expected_results: User role is updated to 'Admin' when 'Make Admin' is clicked.
User role is reverted to 'User' when 'Remove Admin' is clicked.
User is successfully deleted from the user list.
edge_cases: Verify what happens if the 'Make Admin' button is clicked for a user already an admin.
Check behavior when trying to delete the currently logged-in admin.
Ensure proper error handling if the user list fails to load.
Test what happens if the confirmation dialog for deletion is dismissed.
Verify if changes persist after refreshing the page.
data_requirements: A user named 'bhhavya.sureka' in the user list.
Proper role assignments in the database before starting the test.
Database access to verify user roles.
dependencies: Admin user must be logged in.
The user list must be loaded correctly.
The 'Make Admin', 'Remove Admin', and 'Delete User' buttons must be visible.
The database must be accessible to verify changes.
Confirmation dialog functionality must be implemented.
api_interactions: API call to fetch the user list.
API call to update user roles.
API call to delete a user.
performance_metrics: Time taken to update user roles.
Time taken to delete a user.
Response time of API calls for fetching the user list.
accessibility_requirements: Verify that all buttons have proper ARIA labels.
Ensure the user list is navigable using the keyboard.
Check color contrast for role status indicators.
Ensure confirmation dialogs are screen-reader friendly.
Verify that focus is appropriately managed on page navigation.
